processDescription: Laser drilling of titanium uses pulsed laser energy to create precise holes through percussion or trepanning methods. Hole diameters range from 0.05 mm to 3 mm with aspect ratios up to 20:1, specifically for screw. Precision screw for Fastener present unique challenges: Thread form accuracy per ASME B1.1 with Class 3A fit. Micro-screws (< M2) require Swiss turning with CBN tooling.
heatControl: Pulsed fiber laser with nitrogen assist gas. Pulse energy and frequency controlled to minimize recast layer.
